shots.content_purpose: 建立暮色荒漠公路与复古车环境，看见女人走回车尾、男人站在车边不动
shots.description: The video opens on the empty desert highway of <Subject 1> at dusk, the heavy purple cloud bank pressing low over the horizon. <Subject 2> stands angled on the shoulder with its round red tail lights glowing. <Subject 3> walks back along the car's flank toward its rear while <Subject 4> stands beside the front door with his hands in his coat pockets. Wind lifts strands of her wet-look hair and slides the hem of her glossy black dress, which catches a thin red reflection from the tail lights. The camera tracks backward low and level at slow speed, keeping the car and both figures inside the deep frame while her heels crunch once on the loose gravel. She reaches the rear and her black-nailed hand rises to the trunk.

shots.content_purpose: 看清后备箱被打开、箱内露出黑色包袋，建立取包动作起点
shots.cut_reason: 同一连续取包动作需要从整体走位切到后箱视角，才能看清箱盖开启与箱内包袋
shots.continuity_bridge: shot_1 结束于她手抬向箱盖；shot_2 从同一手位继续，手已握住箱盖把手
shots.description: At 00:02.800, the camera cuts to a tighter three-quarter rear view of <Subject 2>. <Subject 3>'s hand grips the trunk handle, the latch releases with a single metallic clack, and she lifts the lid; the open trunk reveals <Subject 5> lying on the trunk floor. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed as the lid settles fully open, and the red tail light blooms across the copper-brown paint beside her hip. She bends forward and reaches into the trunk.

shots.content_purpose: 看清黑色包袋被提起的材质、提手与正面金属扣，确认产品外观
shots.cut_reason: 同一取包动作需拉近到包袋本身，才能看清皮革纹理与金属扣
shots.continuity_bridge: shot_2 结束于她俯身伸手入箱；shot_3 从同一俯身姿态继续，双手已握住双提手
shots.description: At 00:05.000, the camera cuts to a close shot of <Subject 5> as <Subject 3> lifts it clear of the trunk with both hands on the arched handles; the crocodile-embossed black leather and the centered metal clasp catch the cold dusk light, and the stiff handles creak slightly under tension. The camera tilts up with small amplitude as she straightens, the patent leather of her dress mirroring the same cold light. She settles the bag at her right side, the trunk still open behind her.

shots.content_purpose: 看见女人与站在车边的男人之间一瞬间的安静关系，以及由她主动结束这一刻
shots.description: At 00:07.200, the camera cuts to a medium two-shot. <Subject 4> is still standing beside the car; <Subject 3> straightens with <Subject 5> hanging at her side, and their eyes meet. Neither of them moves: only the wind crossing the open road shifts her hair and the edge of his long coat. The camera arcs slowly around the pair with small amplitude, holding both faces in frame, and the air between them stays quiet. She holds his gaze, then turns her head toward the road ahead.

shots.content_purpose: 看见女人提着包背对镜头沿公路走远，车与男人留在原地
shots.description: At 00:09.800, the camera cuts to a wide rear view. <Subject 3> walks away from the camera down the empty highway of <Subject 1> with <Subject 5> swinging faintly at her side, her back to the lens and the glossy dress catching the last light, while <Subject 2> and <Subject 4> remain small and still beside the road. The camera holds a static shot with a slow pull out as she recedes along the shoulder, and gusts push dust across the asphalt.

shots.content_purpose: 以品牌 logo 卡静止收尾
shots.description: At 00:12.200, the shot cuts to black and settles exactly on <Picture 4>, holding the centered white serif wordmark, its subtitle line, and the black background unchanged and completely still through the final frame.
